title: RE: Chestnut Hill Realty plans to install AI-powered license plate reader cameras in South Brookline - Brookline.News
summary: A letter to the editor objects to Brookline's 5-0 approval allowing Chestnut Hill Realty to install Flock AI-powered license plate reader cameras in South Brookline, arguing the cameras are broader surveillance tools, that the free trial creates a path to a town Flock contract, and citing abuse risks including ICE and abortion-patient tracking.

key_quotes.quote: These are AI-enhanced surveillance cameras that capture both still and video footage that is searchable for things far beyond just license plate numbers.
The memorandum states that there is a 12-month free trial of the premium service at which point it gets downgraded. This creates a clear path for Flock to begin contracts directly with the city.
